staged_dissolution.interrupt: Your government no longer exists. Open Campaign to review its history and available continuation choices.

cross_checks.note: Compares the simulation world value of both post-dissolution archives key by key as raw bytes. Envelope history/log may differ by construction: the served aim command records its headline in the archive log, while the exporter calls campaign_aims::choose directly.

observations.summary: The budget card's debt-service line labels the served money.spread as a "sovereign spread at N% of GDP", but for these newborn successors debt is below the 60% knee, where the simulation charges no debt spread. The served money.real_rate is policy rate minus inflation without the simulation's REAL_RATE_FLOOR (-2%), so money.spread = effective_rate - real_rate absorbs the floor. The effective rate itself matches economy::effective_interest_rate; only the breakdown and label disagree.
evidence: spheres-web/src/main.rs fn policy_json money.real_rate and money.spread
